purpose: Test whether an event-triggered, tactile-supported, disjoint-camera direct-depth observation can safely improve a selected physical-or-persistence deformable-object forecast.
claim_boundary: Method lock only. No fresh source cohort, prediction outcome, calibration result, target result, or state-of-the-art claim exists under this artifact.

parent_evidence.v11_lesson: Action support alone did not imply usable tracker support or motion headroom; endpoint support was 5/64 and the admitted provider regressed against persistence.

required_before_selection: one validated composite manifest covering every held-v8 object and attempt disposition
Prob4D exclusion manifest with canonical digest 181796725382bcbe377b824dfac90243c6d3b0c9f9754fbeeb87cb6343d486ff
MolmoMotion-Field exclusion manifest with content digest d25cc3044080459cef47851d292410def8a592aa95478dabeb1db9fa513e925a
all Bayesian-PhysTwin opened, reserved, selected, and technically dispositioned objects through V11
missing_at_method_lock: independently supplied held-v8 all-attempt hash-only exclusion manifest

event_scan.selection_rule: earliest prefix endpoint whose complete causal-response admission artifact passes

camera_panels.unknown_correlation_rule: each panel is one evidence group; no precision multiplication across panels

direct_depth.view_fusion: covariance intersection plus maximum view-scatter inflation

tactile.source: released Deform360 per-gripper tactile stream through the candidate update frame
tactile.baseline_rule: latest timestamped baseline at or before episode recording
tactile.contact_rule: official union over grippers: more than one positive normalized taxel after the released 0.3 threshold
tactile.role: independent causal contact support only; tactile does not define metric geometry or observation reliability

prospective_source_gate_blueprint.advance_action: freeze a disjoint fresh-object target protocol without changing method, event, update, or gate settings
prospective_source_gate_blueprint.fail_action: stop V12 without tuning on source outcomes

forbidden: selecting a fresh cohort before the complete hash-only exclusion union exists
using future tactile, RGB, depth, masks, identities, point clouds, or metrics
using the state innovation to define association probability or prior perception reliability
counting dense pixels, cameras, or pairwise distances as independent evidence
using validation-panel geometry to form the state update
weakening exact fallback or nuisance limits after source outcomes
opening, inspecting, modifying, or rerunning held-v8 artifacts or processes
